result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.set_node_attr_to_display()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Set which node attribute to display in tooltips/labels. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L8479-L8515){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.set_node_attr_to_display(attr=None) ``` ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Attribute name to display. If `None`, shows node ID. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} This only affects how nodes are labeled in rendered visualizations -- it doesn't change any underlying data. Passing `None` resets the display back to node IDs: ::: {#1ae0bc5d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec G = ec.Graph() G.add_node(label="Alice", age=30) G.add_node(label="Bob", age=25) G.add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") G.set_node_attr_to_display(attr="label") G.set_node_attr_to_display(attr=None) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` Number of nodes : 2 Number of edges : 1 Directed : False Density : 1.00 Average degree (min, max) : 1.00 (1, 1) Connected : True Number of connected components : 1 Tree : True Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
